text: A cleanup on 17 September reclaimed 484 GB (free 1.7 T to 2.2 T): every toy set (rebuild is under a second each), the 2.46 M cloud-search-real and loss-decomp-real sets, and 145 GB of tmp-claude. Kept: recall-real and the cutoffs-real draw with its 100 recruited shards. By 6 October the four cutoffs-sp-* sets were gone from sets/ as well; sp-10k rebuilds in seconds from the recipe and calibrates under union in a few minutes.
